description:
Born with blocked meridians, the boy Sowoon was slow to speak and grow. After meeting the esteemed figures of the Wudang Sect, he was cherished like a precious gem and grew up under their care. He eventually formed ties with the Six Martial Lords of the Orthodox Faction monstrous prodigies whose martial prowess defied common sense. Just then, the Demon Cult emerged in the martial world, leading to a grand battle that would shake the land...! The exhilarating and thrilling golden era of Sowoon and the Six Divine Lords in the Jianghu!
